reviews.title: Good price for a good card
reviews.comment: So far a great card for the money and Intel seems to be in it for the long term support wise and constantly and consistently improving driver support . Plays in 4k wuite well on my 65 inch 144 hz tcl weld tv . I’ve not had any graphics issues or performance issues as both are great . I have it paired with an AMD RYZEN 7800x3d 64 gb ddr 5 6400mt’s 32 cl and zero comparability issues . Seems very well built and durable .
reviews.author: vernie l massey
